When planning your business trip, please act as if you're traveling solo, without your family. Here's how it works:

  • Only submit receipts for your own expenses.

Here are some examples of what would count as pressing reasons

  • Family emergency: A close family member is very sick.
  • Health issues: The traveler isn't feeling well.
  • Business needs: A car is needed to get to work on time.
  • Multiple stops: The traveler needs to visit several business locations.
  • Cost-saving: Using a car will be cheaper.
  • Team travel: Other colleagues need a ride.
  • Big items: Heavy or large goods need to be moved.
